title: MCP-Eco: A Linked Dataset of MCP Servers, Consumers, and Development Activity
title_zh: MCP-Eco：MCP 服务器、消费方与开发活动的关联数据集

paragraphs.en: MCP-Eco整合服务器、消费方与开发活动数据，发布含近1700万记录的关联数据集。 The Model Context Protocol (MCP) enables LLM agents to access external tools and data. Studying its software ecosystem requires connecting server interfaces, the projects that configure these servers, and their development activity. However, this information is scattered across directories, package registries, configuration files, and repository histories. We present MCP-Eco, a relational dataset that integrates these sources and links consumer configuration declarations to candidate server projects. Its frozen release contains 16,880,899 records across 19 Parquet tables, covering 78,302 candidate server projects, 16,165 candidate consuming repositories, and 9,200 configuration declarations. Of these declarations, 5,975 resolve to 5,138 distinct repository-server pairs. The dataset also includes tool, resource, and prompt descriptions, declared dependencies, and associated development records, including pull requests, reviews, issues, and commits. Provenance fields distinguish directory-reported capabilities from those observed through live probing and document discovery sources and declaration-matching methods. These connections support research on MCP interface design, configuration practices, and repository maintenance, while enabling practitioners to inspect tool schemas and existing integration configurations. The dataset and accompanying analysis scripts are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/mcp-research-alliance/mcp-ecosystem Demo video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N7TqnNneSfU
paragraphs.zh: MCP-Eco整合了服务器、消费方与开发活动数据，发布了包含近1700万条记录的关联数据集。模型上下文协议（MCP）使大语言模型智能体能够访问外部工具和数据。 研究其软件生态系统需要将服务器接口、配置这些服务器的项目以及它们的开发活动联系起来。 然而，这些信息分散在目录、软件包注册表、配置文件和仓库历史中。 我们提出MCP-Eco，一个整合这些数据源并将消费方配置声明与候选服务器项目关联起来的关联数据集。 其冻结版本包含19个Parquet表中的16,880,899条记录，涵盖78,302个候选服务器项目、16,165个候选消费方仓库以及9,200条配置声明。 在这些声明中，5,975条解析为5,138对不同的仓库-服务器配对。 该数据集还包括工具、资源和提示描述、声明的依赖关系，以及相关的开发记录，包括拉取请求、评审、议题和提交。 来源字段区分了目录报告的能力与通过实时探测观测到的能力，并记录了发现来源和声明匹配方法。 这些关联支持关于MCP接口设计、配置实践和仓库维护的研究，同时使从业者能够检查工具模式及现有的集成配置。 数据集及配套分析脚本已在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/mcp-research-alliance/mcp-ecosystem 公开发布。演示视频：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N7TqnNneSfU
